text:
The hacker who leaked GTA 6 is back. And he set a deadline.
In August, someone calling himself Cyberleek dumped around fifteen gameplay videos online. Take-Two fired back with lawsuits and subpoenas. Nobody has been arrested.
Then he vanished.
Now his website has a new poll. Two options. Both hidden behind question marks. And it closes today, October eighth.
Here's the twist. The same crypto wallet tied to his token just started moving again.
Fans are scared of spoilers. Or even a playable build, six weeks before launch.
But heads up: nobody has confirmed this is the same person. It could be an impostor. And it's still a rumor.
Whatever you do, don't download anything that claims to be the full game. Those files are scams.
So what do you think is hiding behind the question marks? Tell me below.
